title: Design System: Rock Works School of Music

ink.purpose: The dark grounds and all primary text. Black with plum in it.

surface.purpose: Cards and panels sitting on the page.

label-stock.purpose: The alternate band: the woven tag sewn into the garment.

flare.purpose: A SURFACE, never an ink. Large areas and display type at 40px and up.

flare-action.purpose: The button fill. White on it is 6.07:1.

flare-ink.purpose: All red text at reading size. 7.73:1 on the page.

flare-wash.purpose: Red at wash strength, for notices.

lagoon.purpose: Section labels and the focus ring. The Hawaii note.

gold.purpose: Marks and emphasis on a dark ground.

sea-glass.purpose: A section label on a dark band, where gold competes.

white.purpose: Type on a dark ground, and an input's field. Never a page ground.

poster.purpose: The homepage field only. Condensed caps set enormous and tight.

lead.purpose: The standfirst under a heading, and the proof band's statement lines.

body.purpose: The default. Interface copy, card text, lists.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: The only shadow in the system, and hover-only. Printed matter does not float; separation is carried by ground changes and 1px edges.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: Transform and filter on solid buttons.

motion.name: accent
motion.purpose: The instrument marks' accent stroke and fill.

narrative.northStar: The 1950s Hawaiian silkie — the tailored, saturated, collector-grade shirt, not the souvenir rack.
narrative.overview: The world is a printed garment: a saturated FIELD carrying a motif repeat, an engineered BORDER BAND at the hem where the print concentrates and the object states what it is, and LABEL STOCK wherever something has to be read. Blue Hawaii, 1961, is the hinge that makes this rock and roll rather than tourism. It replaced a cream-and-slab-serif world on 2026-08-28 whose largest, brightest element was a small button.
keyCharacteristics: Three grounds, three jobs: flare field, lacquer band, label stock.
Two faces, sharply divided: condensed signage shouts, Franklin Gothic reads.
Surface or ink: every accent is one or the other, decided by measurement.
Corners, not curves: radii top out at 4px and tags are square.
Two worlds ship; the previous design is preserved and switchable.

rules.name: The Surface-or-Ink Rule
rules.body: If a colour sits behind white it is a surface; if the colour IS the letterform at reading size it is an ink. Display numerals at 24px and up are the one exception. This is why there are three reds.

rules.name: The Lagoon Squeeze
rules.body: Lagoon is both label text and the focus ring, so it is squeezed from both ends: 4.5:1 on Label Stock, 3:1 on the dark grounds. Darkening Lacquer breaks the ring as surely as darkening Lagoon does.

rules.name: The Hover Counts Rule
rules.body: Contrast is measured in the state a control is used in, not only the state it is read in. The CTA brightens 4% on hover.

rules.name: The No-Grey Rule
rules.body: No neutral grey. Darks carry plum, lights carry green, label stock carries yellow.

rules.name: The Signage Face Shouts Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders sets headings, numerals, labels and buttons, and never a paragraph.

rules.name: The Twenty-First Size Rule
rules.body: Ten steps. A new fixed size takes the nearest existing step.

rules.name: The Fluid Endpoint Exception
rules.body: clamp() endpoints may sit off the scale; fixed sizes may not. It does not license using clamp() to dodge the scale.

rules.name: The 0.22em Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase labels track at 0.22em; poster and display type track negative. The direction reverses with size.

rules.name: The Three Grounds Rule
rules.body: Every section is a field, a border band, or label stock, and no two adjacent sections share a topology.

rules.name: The Field Is Rationed Rule
rules.body: The flare field belongs to the homepage's opening and closing viewports. Inner pages get a lacquer header with a flare rule.

rules.name: The No Accent Border On A Radius Rule
rules.body: A thick coloured rule curving around a corner reads as a mistake. When they conflict, the corner goes.

rules.name: The Focus Ring Rule
rules.body: 2px Lagoon at 2px offset on every interactive element. The skip link alone uses :focus rather than :focus-visible.

rules.name: Two Button Treatments, Not Three
rules.body: The Button primitive and the auth submit pill coexist deliberately and must not multiply.
